name: Sacred Blood's Instinct
descriptionTemplate: {Embryo Fusion} +[Blood:Arg1], gain Keyflare equal to 2× Thais's Keyflare Regen. Choose: {Blood of Fear}, {Blood of Decay}, {Blood of Coition}
lore:
From eternity, born of ignorance, stemming from fear.
Flowing through Thais' veins is a primordial instinct.
In an unforgettable sacrifice, the young Thais was implanted with this instinct.
Will, emotion, and even personality were replaced by an alien existence—
What remained was the common thread of life: the instinctive fear of death.
